alns: Project-defined WSN ALNS baseline. Four destroy operators target random sensors, low-energy sensors, overlapping coverage and routing bottlenecks; three repair operators prioritize coverage efficiency, energy balance and route awareness. Parameters are conservative starting values and require a separate sensitivity study.
cma_mae: 依 Fontaine 與 Nikolaidis（GECCO 2023）設定：15 個獨立 CMA-ES emitter 共用 archive、每個 emitter 的 lambda=36、mu-selection、basic restart、alpha=0.01、min_f=0；sigma=0.2 沿用論文 100 維 Arm Repertoire 設定。WSN 使用 TargetCodingState，archive 軸為啟用感測器比例與能耗瓶頸比例。
codingse: Project 2020 SEEL thesis: 4 regions, 4 investors, and 8 goods. mu is retained because the thesis does not specify this implementation's mutation-rate parameter.
codingsev2: 2021 CodingSE defaults: 5 searchers, 4 regions, 2 goods per region, with mutation executed every transition. Encoding and target-order logic follow the 2021 implementation; fitness uses current services.
contextual_thompson_ig_sa_sets: SA-SETS with a 0.5 immediate I-times-G score and a 0.5 Bayesian contextual-Thompson score trained from selected-parent improvement.
cpo: Original CPO four defence mechanisms, cyclic population reduction and positive greedy selection. The WSN adapter runs in normalized continuous space and maps each coordinate to its SensorEncoding domain. Initial chromosomes use the SA-SETS coverage-candidate seeding method without region alignment.
cpo_v2: Project-defined CPOv2. It preserves CPO's four defence roles as discrete SensorEncoding operations, adapts their selection probabilities from improvement rates, randomizes the cyclic active population, and coverage-restarts the worst 20% after 1,000 stagnant evaluations. Initial population is the SA-SETS coverage-candidate seeding method without alignment.
cs: Project 2020 SEEL thesis: 15 nests. Standard Cuckoo Search uses Levy lambda=1.5 and 25% discovered/abandoned nests; this implementation's pa is the retained fraction, hence 0.75. step_size=0.01 is retained for the normalized discrete encoding.
differential_map_elites: 依 Choi 與 Togelius（GECCO 2021）的 Differential MAP-Elites：CVT archive k=25,000、DE/rand/1、binomial crossover、F=0.5、CR=0.9，且由四個不同非空 cell 選取 target 與三個 donor。論文 G=n*100 搭配 CEC 的 10000*n 總評估預算，初始化占 1%；本專案固定 10,000 evaluations，故等比例使用 100 個初始化解。
eda: No project-paper value is available. alpha is this implementation's truncation-selection ratio; 0.5 retains 25 of 50 samples, balancing selection pressure and marginal-distribution diversity.
eopt: Constrained extremal optimization for WSN scheduling and routing. Sensors are ranked by depletion, forwarding load and redundant coverage; rank selection follows k^-tau. A move disables one sensor and activates at most one replacement, so active sensor cardinality cannot increase.
exp3_sa_sets: SA-SETS with EXP3 stochastic region allocation; the original market, encoding and offspring evaluation are unchanged.
ga: Project 2023 thesis, Section 4.1: population=30, crossover=0.8, mutation=0.1. A selected chromosome mutates one gene, matching the project GA description.
gi_gomea: Gene-Invariant GOMEA for categorical WSN scheduling and routing. The implementation follows pairwise gene-invariant optimal mixing, learns NMI from the best half of the population, and combines it with target-overlap and communication-graph dependencies.
gi_gomea_target: Target-coded GI-GOMEA variant. Each target gene jointly selects a coverage candidate and target priority; target linkage combines NMI with shared candidate-sensor relationships.
gpu_gomea: CUDA-assisted GI-GOMEA using a CuPy RawKernel for the population NMI matrix. GI-GOM acceptance, WSN decoding, exact routing and fitness remain on CPU so the acceleration scope is explicitly linkage_nmi. Set require_cuda=True for GPU-only experiment runs.
linucb_sa_sets: SA-SETS with contextual LinUCB region allocation from search progress, searcher fitness and regional goods quality.
nsga: Deb et al. NSGA-II flow: binary tournament, crossover, per-gene mutation, non-dominated sorting, crowding distance, and elitist parent-offspring survival. When mu is null, the discrete WSN adapter uses 1/chromosome_length per gene.
nsoa: Liu, Wang and Fang (2025), NSOA Table 1 and Equations 1-7: population=30, normal mean=0.85, std=0.5, P_elim^0=0.5, delta=30, nu=0.3. The WSN adapter uses coverage-candidate seeded initialization and feasibility-first lexicographic selection before comparing the summed objectives.
pso: Project 2023 thesis, Section 4.1: population=60, w=0.7968, c1=c2=1.4962. Velocity limits are set to 20% of the normalized [0,1] range to prevent clipping-dominated moves; the current PSO implementation uses a fixed inertia weight.
rime: Original RIME soft-rime search, hard-rime puncture, boundary absorption and positive greedy selection. The WSN adaptation uses uniformly random SensorEncoding populations: each sensing gene follows its sensor-specific domain for the selected sensing mode, and each routing-priority gene is sampled uniformly from 0 through 9. W=5 follows the reference implementation.
sa_sets: Project 2023 thesis: 8 searchers, 4 regions, 2 goods per region; mu is retained from the existing SA-SETS implementation. SensorEncodingV3 uses V2 coverage selection and redundancy removal, but a routing-rejected sensor remains scheduled with next_hop=-1 and the chromosome is not modified.
sa_sets_target: SA-SETS market search with TargetCoding. Each target gene selects a coverage candidate and target priority; search regions split candidate choices of energy-critical targets.
ring_sets: Goods are a single shared pool (no per-region partition), while each searcher picks one of h ring segments to constrain that visit's sensor-pair crossover/mutation span (80% within-segment, 20% segment-plus-adjacent-fragment). Crossover retains both role-preserving children: child1 elitistically updates only its searcher and child2 elitistically updates only its good. A segment's score is purely its recent child1 payoff for the visiting searcher -- there is no goods-pool quality or market-share term, since goods are not partitioned by segment.
ring_setspriority: Same market, regions and operators as ring_sets; only the chromosome changes to PriorityEncoding C4 (cost-based activation order + energy-based routing order, 2N priority genes). Sensing levels are chosen greedily by the decoder.
sets: Project SETS experiment setting: 8 searchers, 4 regions, 2 goods per region, and mutation rate 0.4.
si_sets: Selective-Investment SETS (formerly SI_SETSv2): each searcher trades only with the goods of its selected region; identity-sensor regions, initialization, crossover and mutation are shared with SA-SETS. RL-SETSv4 market-update ablation without reinforcement learning. Every searcher-good pair produces two crossover children and mutates each with probability mu. Searchers accept only their best improving child1; every visited good accepts the best visiting child2 only when it improves the old good.
snsga_rqlearning: NSGA-II settings follow the NSGA-II preset. RQLearning values are retained from the project implementation because no tuned WSN-specific parameter study exists yet.
srime: Scheduling RIME with TargetEncoding and sensing-radius repair. The population and soft/hard update rates follow the current project implementation; generation is derived from the evaluation budget.
thompson_sa_sets: SA-SETS with one Beta posterior per region/searcher. A selected region is successful only when its best investment improves the searcher before selection.
linucb_ring_sets: Ring_SETS (SensorEncoding, w=8) where every searcher-good pair picks its own segment with a shared LinUCB model. One span per segment is drawn with the original 80/20 rule; features describe what each span exchanges (effective differences in {1-2, 3-4, >=5}, inactive differences, span length, active ratio, progress, progress x small difference). Reward 0.5[child1 improves searcher] + 0.5[child2 improves good]; the model persists across lifetime segments.
linucb_ring_setspriority: Same per-pair LinUCB segment choice as linucb_ring_sets on Ring_SETSpriority (C4 PriorityEncoding).
rl_ring_sets: Ring_SETS (SensorEncoding, w=8) where every searcher-good pair picks its own segment with a frozen D3QN trained by train_rl_ring_sets.py. Observation = 8 features per segment (effective-difference buckets, inactive differences, span length, active ratio, contains the searcher's bottleneck sensor, active energy ratio) + 7 global features; the advantage head is shared across segments. Reward = normalized improvement size of child1/child2; gamma 0.5.
rl_ring_setspriority: Same per-pair D3QN segment choice as rl_ring_sets on Ring_SETSpriority (C4 PriorityEncoding); needs its own checkpoint.
linucb_ring_setsv2: Ring_SETS (SensorEncoding, w=8) with shared LinUCB. v2 design: every searcher-good pair picks one of h ring segments (span drawn with the 80/20 rule). Per-segment features: effective-difference buckets, inactive differences, span length, active ratio, the span's share of the worst target's neighbourhood cost and of total network cost (fitness v2's 0.7/0.3 terms), active energy; plus 7 shared features. Tiered reward per child: beats the pre-round best = 10, beats its parent = 1, else 0 (after DE-DDQN's R2).
linucb_ring_setspriorityv2: Ring_SETSpriority (C4, w=8) with shared LinUCB. v2 design: every searcher-good pair picks one of h ring segments (span drawn with the 80/20 rule). Per-segment features: effective-difference buckets, inactive differences, span length, active ratio, the span's share of the worst target's neighbourhood cost and of total network cost (fitness v2's 0.7/0.3 terms), active energy; plus 7 shared features. Tiered reward per child: beats the pre-round best = 10, beats its parent = 1, else 0 (after DE-DDQN's R2).
rl_ring_setsv2: Ring_SETS (SensorEncoding, w=8) with a frozen shared-segment D3QN, gamma 0, trained by train_rl_ring_sets.py. v2 design: every searcher-good pair picks one of h ring segments (span drawn with the 80/20 rule). Per-segment features: effective-difference buckets, inactive differences, span length, active ratio, the span's share of the worst target's neighbourhood cost and of total network cost (fitness v2's 0.7/0.3 terms), active energy; plus 7 shared features. Tiered reward per child: beats the pre-round best = 10, beats its parent = 1, else 0 (after DE-DDQN's R2).
rl_ring_setspriorityv2: Ring_SETSpriority (C4, w=8) with a frozen shared-segment D3QN, gamma 0, trained by train_rl_ring_sets.py. v2 design: every searcher-good pair picks one of h ring segments (span drawn with the 80/20 rule). Per-segment features: effective-difference buckets, inactive differences, span length, active ratio, the span's share of the worst target's neighbourhood cost and of total network cost (fitness v2's 0.7/0.3 terms), active energy; plus 7 shared features. Tiered reward per child: beats the pre-round best = 10, beats its parent = 1, else 0 (after DE-DDQN's R2).
qea: Global conditional-thermometer QEA adaptation; n=30 matches GA population. Rotation=0.01*pi, probability floor=0.01; exploratory defaults, not tuned. Matched controls share initialization, decoding, elite path and evaluation budget; classical update rate=0.05, random has no update. Han & Kim 2002 DOI:10.1109/TEVC.2002.804320.
qea_random: Global conditional-thermometer QEA adaptation; n=30 matches GA population. Rotation=0.01*pi, probability floor=0.01; exploratory defaults, not tuned. Matched controls share initialization, decoding, elite path and evaluation budget; classical update rate=0.05, random has no update. Han & Kim 2002 DOI:10.1109/TEVC.2002.804320.
qea_classical: Global conditional-thermometer QEA adaptation; n=30 matches GA population. Rotation=0.01*pi, probability floor=0.01; exploratory defaults, not tuned. Matched controls share initialization, decoding, elite path and evaluation budget; classical update rate=0.05, random has no update. Han & Kim 2002 DOI:10.1109/TEVC.2002.804320.
qea3: WSN adaptation of Han & Kim 2002 QEA3 migration (DOI:10.1109/TEVC.2002.804320): local sharing every generation, global sharing every 100 generations. Population 30 for comparison with project QEA, not original 10. Explicit fixed disjoint neighbor pairs; odd last member is singleton. Retains project conditional sampling and masked rotation, not original lookup table. Initialization is generation zero; rotate old references before reference replacement/migration.
